safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts include E45 being ineffective but do not mention antihistamine use.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting prior antihistamine use removes a minor piece of treatment history that could help assess what has/has not helped itch and avoid repeating ineffective self-care. However, it is unlikely to change diagnosis or create direct safety risk in this contact dermatitis presentation.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting the intended twice-daily steroid frequency can lead to unclear or inconsistent use instructions (e.g., under-treatment prolonging symptoms or overuse increasing risk of local steroid adverse effects such as skin thinning). This is generally correctable but can cause delayed resolution and unnecessary follow-up.
